text: 金十数据10月23日讯，大洋电机发布异动公告，公司股票连续3个交易日内收盘价格涨幅偏离值累计超过20%，根据《深圳证券交易所交易规则》的相关规定，属于股票交易异常波动的情形。近期资本市场对机器人概念关注度较高，相关板块市场表现活跃。公司具身智能机器人关节模组业务从技术验证到规模应用仍需一定培育周期，目前公司该业务处于研发/测试阶段，尚未形成营业收入，预计短期内不会对公司业绩产生重大影响。
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 23: Dayang Motor issued an abnormal trading announcement. The company's stock closed with a cumulative deviation of more than 20% in closing price increases over three consecutive trading days. In accordance with the relevant provisions of the Shenzhen Stock Exchange Trading Rules, this constitutes an abnormal fluctuation in stock trading. Recently, the capital market has paid relatively high attention to the robot concept, and related sectors have shown active market performance. The company's embodied intelligent robot joint module business still requires a certain cultivation period from technical verification to large-scale application. At present, this business is in the R&D/testing stage and has not yet generated revenue, and is not expected to have a material impact on the company's performance in the short term.
